correctness.rationale: The complete-minus-antipodes graph of the cross-polytope converts section-vertex counting into exact signed crossing-edge enumeration. With positive offset, r strictly upper signed vertices, s on-plane vertices and the lower antipodes give s+r(2n-r-s-1); with zero offset the r upper/r lower groups give r(r-1)+2(n-r). All pairs are explicitly realized. A signed simplex face crosses a vertex-free plane exactly when its selected vertices contain both signs, establishing the generating function by inclusion-exclusion. Exact enumeration in 252 signed parameter instances and 70 geometric hull instances corroborated the fully general proof, which separately handles endpoints and supporting sections.

value.rationale: The attainable vertex-number sequence and its gaps are explicitly posed as a geometric-combinatorics object in recent literature. The result supplies a complete infinite family classification for both generic and nongeneric slicing, sharp extreme counts, a universal forbidden interval, and an all-face enumerator with an exact quadratic hole count; these are non-arbitrary natural invariants useful for testing general slicing theories.
